subject: Private Offer Amendment: Arcadia Health - capacity & SLA options
messages:
From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.ai>
To: Arcadia Health <contracts@arcadiahealth.com>, Arcadia Procurement <procurement@arcadiahealth.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-07-25T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Private Offer Amendment: Arcadia Health - capacity & SLA options

Hi Maria / team,

Thanks again for the productive call yesterday. Attached is the updated private-offer amendment we discussed (Arcadia_PrivateOffer_Draft_v2.pdf). Key points summarized below:

- Year 1 committed throughput: 500M tokens/month; scheduled ramp to 1B tokens/month by Oct 1, 2027 with interim burst capacity for the first 60 days.
- Option A: Standard SLA (99.9) — no surcharge.
- Option B: SLA uplift to 99.95% — 15% surcharge on committed spend (applies only to Dedicated SKU).
- Billing: prefer quarterly invoicing tied to accepted tranches; open to aligning to your fiscal cadence.

Ask: can you confirm (1) procurement PO line-item format and tax jurisdiction, (2) target signature date (we recommend Aug 5 to avoid rate changes), and (3) whether SOC 2 report needs to be submitted to a specific portal or recipient?

I'll loop in legal and billing as soon as we confirm PO requirements. Happy to hop on a quick call if helpful.

Best,
Evelyn Hart
Head of Renewals, Redwood Inference
E: evelyn_hart@redwood.ai | M: +1 (415) 555-0192
Redwood Inference

Attachment: Arcadia_PrivateOffer_Draft_v2.pdf (Private offer amendment, 6 pages)

From: Maria Lopez <contracts@arcadiahealth.com>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.ai>
Cc: Arcadia Procurement <procurement@arcadiahealth.com>
Date: 2027-07-25T11:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Private Offer Amendment: Arcadia Health - capacity & SLA options

Thanks Evelyn — appreciate the clear summary. A couple of notes from procurement:

- Procurement prefers billing on quarterly invoices tied to funded PO lines; please include a sample invoice line for each tranche.
- We are comfortable with the Oct 1 ramp but would like the ability to push the ramp earlier (Sep 1) if our pilot completes ahead of schedule. Can you confirm whether burst capacity can be enabled earlier without an amendment?
- We need the SOC 2 report (latest snapshot) and a certificate of data-processing practices. Please attach or provide a secure link.

I’ve attached our standard PO template for your legal team to populate (Arcadia_PO_template.docx). If you can populate and return with an estimate of quarterly invoice amounts, we can circulate internally and aim for signature the week of Aug 2.

Maria Lopez
Sr. Contracts Manager, Arcadia Health
contracts@arcadiahealth.com

Attachment: Arcadia_PO_template.docx (PO template)

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
To: Maria Lopez <contracts@arcadiahealth.com>, Arcadia Procurement <procurement@arcadiahealth.com>
Cc: Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.ai>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-07-25T13:20:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Private Offer Amendment: Arcadia Health - capacity & SLA options

Maria — great questions. Quick responses and next steps below.

1) Burst / ramp flexibility: yes — we can enable burst capacity earlier (no contract amendment required) for an initial 30-day period. If you want to accelerate the full ramp to Sep 1, we will adjust the commitment schedule and update the DocuSign SOW before signature.

2) SLA uplift: we can offer the 99.95% SLA option. That would be a 15% uplift on committed spend; we’ve listed the surcharge line in the attached terms doc (private_offer_final_terms.pdf).

3) SOC 2 and DPA: attaching SOC 2 snapshot (soc2_snapshot.pdf) and our DPA link in HubSpot. If you need a notarized attestation or portal upload, let us know and legal will coordinate.

4) Invoice examples: below is a sample quarterly invoice line (illustrative):
   - Q1 (Aug–Oct): Committed tranche A — $125,000 (base) + $18,750 (SLA uplift if selected)

DocuSign: we’ll prepare the final private offer with the selected SLA option and send the DocuSign link to the signatory you specify.

Next action items: Maria — please return the completed PO template with (a) billing contact name/email, (b) tax ID, and (c) preferred signatory (name + title). We’ll aim to have a DocuSign packet to you by EOD Jul 26.

Thanks,
Kimberly Park
Director, Strategic Accounts — Redwood Inference
kimberly_park@redwood.ai

Attachments: private_offer_final_terms.pdf (terms summary), soc2_snapshot.pdf (SOC 2 Type II snapshot)

From: Arcadia Procurement <procurement@arcadiahealth.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>, Maria Lopez <contracts@arcadiahealth.com>
Cc: Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.ai>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-07-26T09:00:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Private Offer Amendment: Arcadia Health - capacity & SLA options

Kim — thanks for the clarity. We can accept the 15% surcharge for the 99.95% SLA. A few items to finalize before signature:

- Invoice remit and tax info: we need Redwood’s remit address and W-9 (or equivalent).
- PO lines: we require separate line-items for base committed spend and SLA uplift.
- Mid-term adjustments: we need language confirming mid-term capacity adjustments are allowed with 30 days notice and no penalty (subject to invoice reconciliation).

We’ve attached a spreadsheet with our remit and billing fields filled out (procurement_remit_details.xlsx). Once you populate the PO template and include sample invoice lines, we’ll route for internal approval.

Procurement Team
Arcadia Health
procurement@arcadiahealth.com

Attachment: procurement_remit_details.xlsx (billing fields)

From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.ai>
To: Arcadia Procurement <procurement@arcadiahealth.com>, Maria Lopez <contracts@arcadiahealth.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-07-26T16:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Private Offer Amendment: Arcadia Health - capacity & SLA options

Thanks — we’ve prepared the populated PO and the final private-offer packet. DocuSign has been sent to the signatory at Arcadia (link below). Summary and next steps:

- DocuSign packet: https://app.docusign.com/arcadia/embedded-sign/12345
- Included: private_offer_final_terms.pdf (with separate invoice lines), populated PO (based on Arcadia_PO_template.docx), SOC2 snapshot, and remit details.
- Mid-term adjustments: confirmed — adjustments allowed with 30 days notice; finance will reconcile on the next invoice cycle (language included in packet).
- Onboarding: looping in Laura Bennett from CS to coordinate the onboarding window and a technical kickoff once PO is in place.

Laura — can you pick two available dates between Aug 8–12 for a 60-minute technical kickoff?

Evelyn Hart
Head of Renewals, Redwood Inference
evelyn_hart@redwood.ai

Note: DocuSign packet includes Doc ID: RDW-ACD-2027-0423 and HubSpot deal link: https://hubspot.redwood.ai/deal/RDW-ACD-2027-0423
